sous_titre: Milliards de colis par an, 2023 à 2025 et projection 2031

2023.texte: In 2024, U.S. parcel volume saw significant growth, reaching 22.37 billion shipments, a 3.4% increase from 2023's 21.65 billion.

2024.texte: In 2024, U.S. parcel volume saw significant growth, reaching 22.37 billion shipments, a 3.4% increase from 2023's 21.65 billion.

2025.texte: In 2025, U.S. parcel volume saw significant growth, reaching 23.1 billion shipments, a 3.3% increase from 2024's 22.4 billion.

2031 (projection).texte: This growth trend is expected to continue with projections showing volumes reaching 31 billion by 2031.
